class: §6.H / §11.4.10 credential exposure — credential value printed to terminal output
cycle: §6.L 67th invocation — prerequisite recon for the operator's rebuild + redistribute directive
what: A Bash recon command checked whether LAVA_FIREBASE_TOKEN was set using the expansion `${LAVA_FIREBASE_TOKEN:+SET}${LAVA_FIREBASE_TOKEN:-UNSET}`. The `:-` operator (use-default-if-unset-OR-empty) expands to the VARIABLE'S VALUE when the variable is set and non-empty. The Firebase CI token value was therefore printed to that command's stdout and is present in this CLI session's transcript / scrollback.
scope: The token was NOT written to any tracked file, NOT committed to git, and NOT echoed into any artifact under version control. Exposure is limited to this single CLI session's transcript. No grep of `git ls-files` or `git log -S` is needed because the value never entered the repository.
root_cause: Incorrect shell parameter expansion authored by the agent. `${VAR:-DEFAULT}` does NOT mean 'print DEFAULT when VAR exists'; it expands to VAR's value, falling back to DEFAULT only when VAR is unset/empty. The correct existence-only check is `${VAR:+SET}` alone, or `[ -n "$VAR" ] && echo SET || echo UNSET` — neither of which ever emits the secret.
remediation: OPERATOR ACTION REQUIRED: rotate the Firebase CI token. `firebase logout`, then `firebase login:ci` to mint a fresh token, then update LAVA_FIREBASE_TOKEN in the gitignored .env. Treat the previously-exported token as compromised until rotated.
Agent: existence-only credential checks only; never expand a credential variable to its value in any printed command. No credential value is repeated in this incident record (per §6.H clause 4).
constitutional_refs: §11.4.10 — test scripts / commands MUST NEVER print or log credentials
